name: Drupal 8+ to Drupal 8+ migration
description: Migration from one Drupal 8+ site to another.
project_description:
This is an Migrate source to import Data from a Drupal 8+ site.

 Much of the features of this module moved into Core under [#2935951].

 Currently provides a re-usable source plugin for the majority of entities 'd8_entity'.

 See core issue and use it instead. The lone exception for D8+ to D8+ migrations is when you need the source and destination are not the same database. Across sites/databases, you will still need to use this module.

 A contributed guide: How to migrate from Drupal 8 to Drupal 9 

 Contributions are very welcome, we are also interested in co-maintainers.

 This has been tested in real life with a wide variety of source data. Including commerce products, payments and product variations. It also works equally well on custom entities, where it has been used to extract data from address fields. Please report any bugs in the issue queue.
